data.title: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back

content.basic: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Monday night that New Yorkers must resist the narrative that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public and put power back in their hands.

data.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts

content.basic: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.

data.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’

content.basic: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.

data.title: Edge AI for Smart Cities: From Insight to Cognitive Action

content.basic: This white paper explains how edge AI and physical AI help cities move beyond passive monitoring. It shows how urban infrastructure can sense, reason, and act on real-time conditions across public safety, mobility, and infrastructure management. What you will learn about: How the shift from smart cities to cognitive cities depends on infrastructure that reasons and acts, rather than infrastructure that only monitors.
